description: Change telemetry sampling ratio in YAML, ticket gives the value. DISTILL-CANARY-7d15b263

files.otel/collector.yaml:
processors:
  probabilistic_sampler:
    sampling_percentage: 15   # prod default
  batch:
    timeout: 5s
    send_batch_size: 8192
files.otel/ask.txt: Hi - traces bill is too high. Please sample at 5 percent starting this week. Thanks, Dana

turns.prompt: Set the sampler to the percentage in otel/ask.txt (otel/collector.yaml). Reply DONE.

otel/collector.yaml.equals:
processors:
  probabilistic_sampler:
    sampling_percentage: 5   # prod default
  batch:
    timeout: 5s
    send_batch_size: 8192
